content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
the light:
- the inserts: the posts around them softened and bulged as I pressed them in, and the inserts sit crooked.
- hanging it: it won't drop onto the wall screws.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.
I'll fix both problems in the design: the insert bosses and the keyholes.

slot sized generously"},"port_slot_h":{"value":7,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"port_slot_z":{"value":24.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"wire_slot_w":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"wire_slot_h":{"value":5,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"wire_slot_y":{"value":100,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"}}, "parts": [{"id":"shell","role":"final","material":"matte white PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    R = p.box_od/2.0
    ri = R - p.wall
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(p.back_t)
    body = body.union(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).circle(ri).extrude(p.rim_h))
    dx = p.pb_hole_sx/2.0; dy = p.pb_hole_sy/2.0; cy = p.pb_cy
    pts = [(dx, cy+dy), (-dx, cy+dy), (dx, cy-dy), (-dx, cy-dy)]
    for (x, y) in pts:
        s = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.back_t).center(x, y).circle(p.standoff_od/2.0).extrude(p.pb_standoff_h)
        body = body.union(s)
    rp = [(p.rim_r_ins*math.cos(math.radians(a)), p.rim_r_ins*math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in (0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300)]
    boss = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.rim_h-6).pushPoints(rp).circle(p.insert_boss_d/2.0).extrude(6)
    body = body.union(boss)
    pil = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.back_t+0.5).pushPoints(pts).circle(p.m2_pilot_d/2.0).extrude(p.pb_standoff_h+2)
    body = body.cut(pil)
    for x in (-p.kh_x, p.kh_x):
        hole = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(x, p.kh_y).circle(p.kh_d/2.0).extrude(p.back_t+2)
        slot = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(x, p.kh_y - p.kh_slot_len/2.0).rect(p.kh_slot_w, p.kh_slot_len).extrude(p.back_t+2)
        body = body.cut(hole).cut(slot)
    ins = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.rim_h-4).pushPoints(rp).circle(p.insert_hole_d/2.0).extrude(5)
    body = body.cut(ins)
    port = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.port_slot_w, 12, p.port_slot_h).translate((0, -117.5, p.port_slot_z))
    body = body.cut(port)
    return body","print_orientation":"back plate on the bed, rim opening up","use_orientation":"back plate flat against the wall, rim toward the viewer"},{"id":"lid","role":"final","material":"matte white PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    R = p.box_od/2.0
    lid = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(p.lid_t)
    rp = [(p.rim_r_ins*math.cos(math.radians(a)), p.rim_r_ins*math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in (0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300)]
    dpts = [(p.disc_hole_x, 0), (-p.disc_hole_x, 0)]
    cb = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.lid_t-p.cb_depth).pushPoints(rp).circle(p.cb_d/2.0).extrude(p.cb_depth+1)
    th = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).pushPoints(rp).circle(p.clear_d/2.0).extrude(p.lid_t+2)
    dh = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).pushPoints(dpts).circle(p.insert_hole_d/2.0).extrude(p.lid_t+2)
    ws = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(0, p.wire_slot_y).rect(p.wire_slot_w, p.wire_slot_h).extrude(p.lid_t+2)
    return lid.cut(cb).cut(th).cut(dh).cut(ws)","print_orientation":"inner face (shell side) on the bed","use_orientation":"on top of the rim, disc side up"}], "hardware": [{"id":"disc","ref":"own:led-disk"},{"id":"perfboard","ref":"own:perfboard"},{"id":"esp32","ref":"own:esp32"},{"id":"m2_screw","ref":"own:m2x6-self-tapping","qty":4},{"id":"m3_screw","ref":"ISO 4762 M3x6","qty":8},{"id":"insert","ref":"insert M3x4x5","qty":8}], "assembly": {"parts":[{"part":"shell","origin":[0,0,0],"x_axis":[1,0,0],"z_axis":[0,0,1]},{"part":"lid","origin":[0,0,34],"x_axis":[1,0,0],"z_axis":[0,0,1]}],"items":[{"item":"disc","origin":[0,0,38],"x_axis":[1,0,0],"z_axis":[0,0,1]},{"item":"perfboard","origin":[0,-72,10.6],"x_axis":[1,0,0],"z_axis":[0,0,1]},{"item":"esp32","origin":[0,-108.4,24.5],"x_axis":[0,-1,0],"z_axis":[0,0,1]}],"screws":[{"item":"m3_screw","head":[16.75,0,40],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[-16.75,0,40],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[114.5,0,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[57.25,99.15,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[-57.25,99.15,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[-114.5,0,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[-57.25,-99.15,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m3_screw","head":[57.25,-99.15,35],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m2_screw","head":[22.9,-38.9,10.6],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m2_screw","head":[-22.9,-38.9,10.6],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m2_screw","head":[22.9,-105.1,10.6],"direction":[0,0,-1]},{"item":"m2_screw","head":[-22.9,-105.1,10.6],"direction":[0,0,-1]}]}, "manual": [{"n":"1","text":"Print the shell (back plate on the bed) and the lid (inner face on the bed).
